newsitem.title: LATVIA: SOCCER-AUSTRIA CAPITALISE ON SENDING OFF.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-AUSTRIA CAPITALISE ON SENDING OFF.

text.p: Austria took advantage of a depleted Latvia to win their World Cup European zone group four qualifier 3-1 on Sunday.

The 39th minute sending off of midfielder Marian Pahars turned the match for the Austrians, allowing them to increase the pressure in the second half after an evenly matched first period, when both teams missed chances.
"The game was actually decided by the sending off. After that, it was a theatre with only one actor and it was difficult to recover," said Latvian coach Janis Gilis.
Austria broke throughwere after 55 minutes when a corner kick yielded the first goal for Andreas Heraf.
Anton Polster made it 2-0 after 81 minutes after several minutes of intense pressure deep in the Latvian half. He managed to swerve past a defender and fired the ball into the far right-hand corner.
The vistors sealed victory in the 85th minute when substitute Peter Stoger received the ball right in front of the embattled Latvian goal and fired past goalkeeper Oleg Karavajev.
Latvia's consolation goal came in the 87th minute when Vitali Astafjev converted a long pass across goal from the right.
